summary: two tasks are declared with the same explicit id
help: Give each task a distinct id.
rationale: Dependencies written as after or until refer to the id, so a duplicate makes the reference target ambiguous.

summary: a task references an id that no task defines
help: Define the referenced task id, or fix the spelling.
rationale: Mermaid places a task whose dependency is undefined at the chart start, so the schedule is silently wrong.

help: Add tasks to the section, or remove it.
rationale: An empty section renders a header over nothing.
